symptoms.label: Jerking or slipping
symptoms.text: A jerk between gears, or revs that climb without the car pulling, can start in several places: the fluid, the clutch packs or the valve body. Guessing gets expensive, so we check first and repair only what is needed.
symptoms.tip: Tell Jason when it happens: pulling off, at one gear change, or all the time.

symptoms.label: Slow to engage D or R
symptoms.text: A pause before Drive or Reverse catches is worth checking early. Fluid condition, solenoids and wear-and-tear parts are all on our list, and the checks come before any parts.
symptoms.tip: Mention if it is worse on a cold start or after a long drive.

symptoms.label: Warning light or limp mode
symptoms.text: A gearbox warning light or limp mode means the car has flagged a problem it does not like. Reading what the car reports is the first step. TCU / TCM repair and programming is one of our services.
symptoms.tip: A photo of the dashboard light on WhatsApp helps.

symptoms.label: Hybrid DCT shudder
symptoms.text: Shudder or judder on take-off in a hybrid double-clutch gearbox is work we do. We have overhauled a Honda Vezel Hybrid double-clutch gearbox, and DCT repair and replacement is one of our services.
symptoms.tip: Send Jason the model, year and whether it shudders cold, warm or both.

steps.name: Diagnose
steps.text: Tell Jason what the car is doing. The car comes in and we find where the problem really is.

steps.name: Open and inspect
steps.text: When the gearbox has to come apart, it is laid out on the bench so every part can be seen.

steps.name: Repair only what is needed
steps.text: Worn or faulty parts are fixed or replaced. The parts that are fine stay in.

steps.name: Refit and test

faq.q: What does "we only repair what is needed" mean?
faq.a: We check the gearbox first and fix the parts that are actually worn or faulty. We do not assume the whole unit has to be replaced.

faq.q: Which cars do you work on?
faq.a: Hybrid, Japanese, Korean and Continental cars. Past jobs include a Honda Vezel Hybrid double-clutch gearbox overhaul and an Audi A6 with a reconditioned Transmission Control Unit, programming and fresh transmission fluid. For a specific model, WhatsApp Jason to confirm.

faq.q: What gearbox work do you do?
faq.a: Gearbox overhaul and repair (automatic, double-clutch and hybrid), DCT repair and replacement, reconditioned mechatronics and solenoid replacement, TCU / TCM repair and programming, valve body servicing, torque converter repair, flywheel and pulley chain replacement, wear-and-tear transmission parts, and transmission fluid (ATF / DCTF) and engine oil servicing.

faq.q: How much does a gearbox overhaul cost?
faq.a: It depends on the car and on what the inspection finds, so we do not list prices here. WhatsApp Jason to confirm for your car.

faq.q: How long does an overhaul take?
faq.a: It depends on the gearbox and the parts it needs. WhatsApp Jason to confirm the timing for your car.
